title: Reeb spaces of 1st derivatives of proper submersions of certain classes
summary: We study the (canonical) 1st derivatives of {\it proper} submersions represented as height functions and belonging to a certain class: a proper map means a map the preimage of a compact set by which is always compact. We investigate their {\it Reeb spaces}. They are the quotient spaces defined by the equivalence relations on the manifolds of the domains where we identify two points in a same connected component of a same level set of them.
